name: h3-chain-story
description: История из 2 сцен (MiniMax-H3 Ref2VA, якорный референс + латентный хвост): стартовый кадр (<Picture 1>) → Сцена 1 → продолжение по хвосту (tail → context) с тем же якорем <Picture 1> → Сцена 2 → склейка

opening_prompt.default: orange tabby cat with white paws sitting in a cozy dusty attic next to an old brass lantern, 3D cartoon, warm golden light, film still

scene1.default: the orange tabby cat with white paws from <Picture 1> looks around the dim dusty attic curiously, camera slowly pushes in, soft creaking floorboards and gentle wind, quiet meow, 3D cartoon

scene2.description: сцена 2 (продолжение с хвоста с удержанием героя по <Picture 1>)
scene2.default: the same orange tabby cat with white paws from <Picture 1> reaches out with its front paw to the brass lantern in the dusty attic and turns the knob, warm golden glow illuminates dusty boxes, camera gently orbits, soft click and quiet purring, 3D cartoon

model.description: видеомодель (по умолчанию minimax-h3-ref2va — удерживает героя и мир по <Picture 1> на обеих сценах)
